explanation: Exact-match employee lookup returning multiple fields on versions that support XLOOKUP.
solution_outline: Return employee details by employee ID.
Expected: exact employee matches return the intended columns; unknown IDs show a clear not-found state and duplicate IDs are flagged.
The solution must be verified using the included sample data; the text check alone is not evidence that the workbook itself meets the rubric.
